name: 営業状況と閉店時刻から時間表を開く行
prompt: Make a compact Japanese Lighthouse hours-disclosure row following the native Japanese reference. White background, one horizontal row only. Original clock glyph anatomy: thin outlined circle, minute hand vertical up and short hour hand angled down-right, no dots or extra clock marks. Utility clock in coherent neutral slate #526173, modest 22px role. Then exact '営業中' in forest green #1F6444, Meiryo Regular14/24, never bold. Then exact '・22:00に終了' in #6E6E6E Meiryo Regular12/16, same baseline. At far right a small thin downward V chevron in slate, like source glyph, not filled triangle, no stem. Preserve source open-until22:00 state exactly. Match native compact spacing and alignment with flexible blank space before right chevron. Tight wide LOW-HEIGHT white strip, ideally390x77 aspect or wider, very small top/bottom padding, no poster-like blank expanse. Do not enlarge text to title size. No borders, cards, heading, new buttons, shadows, mint surfaces, or extra green emphasis. All row content complete and readable; static raster example, not current business hours.
reviewNotes: Original clock hand anatomy, open-until22:00 status, Regular text and slate downward chevron are correct. Compact strip proportions/spacing not achieved: oversized row and excess vertical white canvas, time cluster displaced vs mock. LH01-0101 explicit compact-framing correction already failed same low-height class; no unchanged retry without new hypothesis. Raster candidate only.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
